snippet.title: PlayStation - Eko Eko Azaraku - Wizard of Darkness (1995) - [Intro]
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Eko Eko Azaraku: Wizard of Darkness is an Adventure game, published by Polygram Magic of Japan, which was released in Japan in 1995.
